name: spt-app-project
description: SaaS Multi-tenant para gestión de reservas de centros deportivos

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,SHELL,ADMIN,PORTAL,USERS" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:shell" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:users"
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SHELL,ADMIN,PORTAL,USERS" -c "green.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:shell" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:users"
scripts.dev:shell: cd apps/frontend && npx ng serve spt-app
scripts.dev:admin: cd apps/frontend && npx ng serve spt-admin
scripts.dev:portal: cd apps/frontend && npx ng serve spt-portal
scripts.dev:users: cd apps/frontend && npx ng serve spt-users
scripts.build:all: cd apps/frontend && npx ng build spt-admin && npx ng build spt-portal && npx ng build spt-users && npx ng build spt-app
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:backend:cov && npm run test:frontend:cov
